Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000675" [constraint]: Do not upgrade the ledger service past Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000672" [constraint]: Changes to the billing service need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000667": On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000664" [decision]: Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing service, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000661": As of 2025-09-08, billing-api has a new dependency on the feature-flags service.  (about: billing service, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000654": As of 2025-09-08, Marcus is the Team Boreal on-call primary instead of Lena.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000646": As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team.  (about: Team Atlas, Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000642": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000605": As of 2025-08-26, the event bus is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Cinder, event bus)
- memory_id "1000565": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Team Cinder, billing service)
- memory_id "1000562": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder reported that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000556" [decision]: On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Team Cinder, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000525": As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000518": On 2025-07-03, Team Cinder noticed the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent following the traffic shift and flagged it, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, event bus)
- memory_id "1000485": On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000436" [decision]: On 2025-06-13, the Ember team decided the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000352" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000349": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000345": During INC-2025-011, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000338" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000314": The reporting service depends on the ledger.  (about: ledger, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000213": The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000208": The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings.  (about: ledger, billing service)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger)
